title: MX key on a board: switch and DSA keycap
note: One key as the macropad has it: an MX switch soldered to the board (no plate) and a DSA keycap on its stem. The board's top is z = 0.

fits.note: Slot over the stem: snug, a light press at most
fits.label: Stem in slot

fits.note: Cap doesn't press into the housing at rest
fits.label: Cap on housing
